summary: Employers lose finalists mainly to a competing offer or pay below what the person expected.
realLife: A staffing survey summarized by SHRM found candidates declined offers about a tenth of the time, mostly for a competing offer or pay and benefits below expectations.
sources: Society for Human Resource Management, How to Prevent Rejected Job Offers: https://www.shrm.org/topics-tools/news/talent-acquisition/how-to-prevent-rejected-job-offers
inGame: employer's open position stays unfilled after a decline; wages in the job row decide acceptance.

turns.summary: The employer matches and the candidate accepts.
The next in line is hired.
The job stays open for months.
